schemes.scheme_name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana for Backward Classes
schemes.administering_body: Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam (HBCKN)
schemes.benefit_summary: Concessional loan for an income-generating activity: up to INR 1.25 lakh for an individual and INR 15 lakh for an SHG (up to 20 members). Published NBCFDC terms show 4% beneficiary interest, repayment up to 4 years and a 6-month principal moratorium.
schemes.eligibility_text: Woman entrepreneur; permanent Haryana resident; notified Backward Class; family income up to INR 3 lakh; PPP required. myScheme reports age 18–55. SHGs should have at least 60% Backward Class members; up to 40% may be from other weaker sections.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm the operative age rule, definition/proof of family income, and whether the individual or SHG route is open in the applicant's district.
schemes.exclusions_text: Outside the notified class, residence or income conditions; SHGs not meeting the composition rule.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar; recent photograph; Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP); valid Backward Class certificate.
schemes.conditional_documents: District office may also request bank passbook, income evidence, quotation/business proposal, and SHG registration/resolution/member details.
schemes.application_mode: Online with district verification
schemes.application_steps: 1) Open HBCKN application page. 2) Register and authenticate applicant/PPP. 3) Select scheme and district. 4) Enter personal, category, bank and enterprise details. 5) Upload documents. 6) Submit and save application number. 7) Respond to District Manager verification.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline located. Apply while portal is open; SARAL service time is published as 135 days.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Track: https://www.hbews.org.in/appstatus or https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/ . HBCKN: +91-172-2701722; hbckn222@gmail.com.
schemes.source_authority: Official finance terms + current Haryana agency portal; some eligibility fields need agency confirmation.
schemes.next_review_action: Call district HBCKN office before submission to confirm active channel, age limit, income proof and complete checklist.

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme – Himachal Pradesh
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment / ESOMSA, Himachal Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension reported by current HP sources: INR 1,000 for ages 40–69 and INR 1,500 at age 70 and above, including applicable state top-up.
schemes.eligibility_text: Widow; resident of Himachal Pradesh; age 40–79; belongs to a Below Poverty Line family.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Official pages differ slightly on whether the higher rate begins at '70 and above' or 'above 70'. Confirm for an applicant turning 70.
schemes.exclusions_text: Applicants not meeting widow, residence, age or current BPL conditions.
schemes.documents_required: Prescribed pension form; Aadhaar; latest BPL certificate; Panchayat recommendation; Parivar Register copy; bank account/passbook details.
schemes.conditional_documents: Carry husband's death certificate and age proof; some offices may request them even when not shown in the latest district checklist.
schemes.application_mode: Offline through local welfare administration
schemes.application_steps: 1) Download/collect form. 2) Complete it and attach documents. 3) Submit through Gram Panchayat, Tehsil Welfare Officer or District Welfare Officer. 4) Local/Gram Sabha verification. 5) Tehsil/District office processes sanction. 6) Pension is credited after approval.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline or renewal cycle found; report eligibility changes.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Ask Tehsil/District Welfare Office for status. ESOMSA: 0177-3525101/5102. Grievance: 1100 or https://www.cmsankalp.hp.gov.in/ .
schemes.source_authority: Official HP district and departmental sources; offline route is the reliable current path.
schemes.next_review_action: Confirm exact age-band wording and whether the district accepts online initiation; use offline unless directed otherwise.

schemes.scheme_name: Dependent Children Pension Scheme
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.benefit_summary: Financial assistance for eligible dependent children. The current official service PDF does not clearly publish the benefit amount; do not rely on older figures without confirmation.
schemes.eligibility_text: Child below 21 whose mother, father or both parents have died; or whose parents are regularly absent; or whose parent(s) are physically/mentally incapacitated or unable to care for the child. A successor/relative may be nominated by the SDM as guardian.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm current family/guardian income ceiling, Punjab residence/property conditions and exact benefit with 1100 or the department.
schemes.exclusions_text: Child aged 21 or above; circumstances not meeting dependency conditions; other operative pension-rule disqualifications may apply.
schemes.documents_required: Applicant identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Passport/Driving Licence/PAN); address proof; applicant and each child's DOB proof (Aadhaar/Voter list/Birth/Matric certificate); bank passbook.
schemes.conditional_documents: Guardian: death certificates of both parents. Mother after father's death: father's death certificate. Disabled father: disability certificate. Missing parent: office may ask for FIR/self-declaration.
schemes.application_mode: Sewa Kendra, Connect Punjab, or doorstep service
schemes.application_steps: Sewa Kendra: visit with papers, take token, submit form-less request, retain receipt. Online: register at Connect Punjab, complete profile, choose pension service, upload and submit. Doorstep: call 1076, book appointment, show papers during home visit.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline found. Published service time: about 34 days via Sewa Kendra/doorstep and 32 days online.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Track in Connect Punjab or with receipt/reference number. Help 1100; doorstep 1076; WhatsApp 98555 01076.
schemes.source_authority: Current official Punjab service PDF for channel/documents; benefit and several rules remain unresolved.
schemes.next_review_action: Call 1100 before submission to confirm benefit, income/residence rules and district-specific declarations.

schemes.scheme_name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme – Chandigarh
schemes.administering_body: Ministry of MSME / KVIC; Chandigarh District Industries Centre
schemes.benefit_summary: New micro-enterprises: maximum project cost INR 50 lakh manufacturing or INR 20 lakh business/service. Own contribution: 10% general, 5% special. Subsidy: general 15% urban/25% rural; special 25% urban/35% rural, subject to appraisal.
schemes.eligibility_text: Individual above 18; no income ceiling; Class 8 pass for manufacturing projects above INR 10 lakh or business/service above INR 5 lakh; new viable unit only. Eligible SHGs/societies/co-ops/trusts. One person per family (self, spouse, unmarried children). Udyam required before verification/subsidy adjustment.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm current-cycle targets/cut-off. Activity eligibility can be fact-specific, especially trading, transport, agriculture-linked and food activities.
schemes.exclusions_text: Existing/subsidised units; projects without capital expenditure; land cost; prohibited intoxicants/tobacco/liquor/thin-polythene activities; many direct cultivation/plantation/animal-husbandry activities except permitted value-add; other negative-list projects.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar/accepted ID; PAN; photograph; detailed project report; education certificate; bank details; caste/special-category certificate if claimed; rural-area certificate if applicable.
schemes.conditional_documents: EDP certificate if completed; entity registration/bylaws/authorisation; licences, quotations or technical papers requested by bank; Udyam before verification.
schemes.application_mode: Online with DIC/KVIC/bank processing
schemes.application_steps: 1) Prepare DPR and scans. 2) Apply on PMEGP portal and select agency/DIC. 3) Save ID. 4) Agency scrutinises. 5) Bank appraises. 6) Complete EDP. 7) Deposit contribution/complete first disbursement. 8) Establish unit, obtain Udyam and complete verification. 9) Subsidy remains in TDR during lock-in before adjustment.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No universal annual deadline; portal/targets govern availability. Agency forwarding up to 3 weeks; bank appraisal up to 60 days. Lock-in generally 3 years.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Use portal ID. DIC Chandigarh: Plot 39, Industrial Area Phase II; 0172-2679007 / 0172-2653140; dic-chd@nic.in. Portal grievance: support-pmegp@msme.gov.in.
schemes.source_authority: Official Ministry/KVIC guideline and portal plus Chandigarh contact.
schemes.next_review_action: Before investing, ask DIC/bank to confirm activity is permitted and whether a current-cycle local limit changed.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.administering_body: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
schemes.benefit_summary: INR 6,000 per year per eligible farmer family, paid by DBT in three equal instalments of INR 2,000.
schemes.eligibility_text: Landholding farmer family with cultivable land in State/UT land records, subject to exclusions. Family means husband, wife and minor children; one benefit per family. Scheme expanded beyond the old 2-hectare limit.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: State land-record matching and payment validation vary. Confirm mutation/ownership is current and beneficiary name matches Aadhaar and bank.
schemes.exclusions_text: Institutional landholders; specified constitutional/elected office-holders; most government/PSE/autonomous/local-body staff except MTS/Class IV/Group D; pensioners at INR 10,000+ monthly with same exception; last-year income-tax payers; practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs and architects.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar; Aadhaar-linked mobile for OTP; bank account and IFSC; land ownership/revenue record or mutation details; mobile; declaration/consent.
schemes.conditional_documents: For assisted eKYC carry Aadhaar to CSC/State Seva Kendra. State may request extra land/family verification. Ensure bank-Aadhaar/NPCI mapping.
schemes.application_mode: Online self-registration or assisted/offline
schemes.application_steps: 1) Update land mutation/family details. 2) Open Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration, or visit Patwari/revenue officer/nodal officer/CSC. 3) Enter Aadhaar, state, land and bank details. 4) Complete mandatory eKYC by OTP, face auth or biometric. 5) Check status and correct Aadhaar/name/land issues.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline. eKYC mandatory; correct records whenever status shows hold/validation failure.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Status: https://pmkisan.gov.in/BeneficiaryStatus_New.aspx . Registration: https://pmkisan.gov.in/farmerstatus.aspx . Grievance: https://pmkisan.gov.in/grievance.aspx . Also on UMANG.
schemes.source_authority: Official PM-KISAN/PIB sources; UMANG is a service channel, not the eligibility authority.
schemes.next_review_action: Use current PM-KISAN portal, not old 2-hectare summaries; resolve eKYC, land-seeding and bank-validation warnings.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat–Chirayu Haryana (including PM-JAY / Haryana expansion)
schemes.administering_body: Haryana State Health Agency / Ayushman Bharat Haryana; National Health Authority for PM-JAY; district civil hospitals, CSCs and empanelled hospitals
schemes.benefit_summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year at public and empanelled private hospitals. Haryana families with verified annual PPP income up to Rs 1.80 lakh are covered without a premium under Chirayu; families with verified income above Rs 1.80 lakh and up to Rs 3.00 lakh may opt in by paying Rs 1,500 per family per year. PM-JAY eligible households are also covered under the same Rs 5 lakh family-floater benefit.
schemes.eligibility_text: For the Haryana Chirayu route, the implementation page identifies Haryana families whose Family ID/PPP income is verified at or below Rs 1.80 lakh per year, with the later extension covering verified income above Rs 1.80 lakh up to Rs 3.00 lakh on payment of Rs 1,500 per family per year. PM-JAY eligibility additionally follows the national deprivation/occupational database and Haryana MMAPUY/other notified state routes. There is no family-size, age or gender cap for an eligible PM-JAY family; pre-existing conditions are covered under PM-JAY.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm whether any 2026-27 Haryana income-band or contribution changes have been notified, and whether the Rs 1,500 extension is still opt-in for every family in the Rs 1.80–3.00 lakh band. PM-JAY database inclusion and Chirayu PPP verification are separate tests; do not treat a PPP income match alone as a guarantee of PM-JAY entitlement.
schemes.exclusions_text: Not eligible through the Haryana expansion if Family ID/PPP income or family verification fails, the household is outside the notified Haryana bands, or the optional contribution is not paid for the Rs 1.80–3.00 lakh route. Treatment must be for a covered package at an empanelled facility. PM-JAY exclusion/inclusion continues to follow the national eligibility database and applicable scheme rules.
schemes.documents_required: Haryana Family ID / Parivar Pehchan Patra (mandatory for the Haryana Chirayu route); Aadhaar or another prescribed identity document for beneficiary identification/card creation; PM-JAY/CM entitlement letter or beneficiary record, where applicable; Ration card, where requested for identification; Bank/payment proof for the Rs 1,500 optional contribution route, if the portal asks for it
schemes.conditional_documents: Disability, age or other identity documents only where a particular beneficiary record requires correction/verification; Contribution receipt for the Rs 1.80–3.00 lakh voluntary route; Hospital referral/medical records are treatment documents, not normally enrolment documents
schemes.application_mode: Eligibility search and e-card generation online, or assisted at a CSC, district civil hospital/camp or Ayushman desk; treatment is obtained at an empanelled hospital.
schemes.application_steps: Check the family on the official PM-JAY eligibility search and/or Haryana Ayushman portal using Family ID/required identity details.; If eligible, complete e-KYC/card creation online, through a CSC, or at a district civil hospital/Ayushman desk; carry the prescribed identity documents.; For the Rs 1.80–3.00 lakh Haryana extension, confirm the verified PPP income and pay the notified Rs 1,500 annual family contribution if opting in.; Download/receive the Ayushman card and take it with identity proof to an empanelled hospital; ask the Ayushman desk to pre-authorise the covered package.; For a failed eligibility search, card error or denial, call the national/Haryana helplines and lodge a grievance.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No annual application deadline stated in the cited sources. Eligibility and contribution status should be rechecked when Family ID/income changes or at the annual contribution cycle; card remains usable while entitlement is active.
schemes.tracking_grievance: PM-JAY/Haryana helplines 14555, 1800111565 and 18001802415; official Haryana feedback/grievance link; Ayushman Saarthi portal and Ayushman desks at hospitals/civil hospitals. Track eligibility/card through the PM-JAY beneficiary search.
schemes.source_authority: Government of Haryana, Ayushman Bharat Haryana / Haryana State Health Agency; PRMS official press releases; National Health Authority PM-JAY portal
schemes.next_review_action: Recheck the Haryana State Health Agency notification and PM-JAY search in the next data refresh for the current contribution amount, income bands and beneficiary-card document checklist.

schemes.scheme_name: Old Age Samman Allowance Scheme
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana; District Social Welfare Officer (DSWO); PFMS for direct benefit transfer
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 3,200 per month per eligible beneficiary with effect from 1 November 2025, paid through PFMS directly to the beneficiary bank account.
schemes.eligibility_text: Applicant must be at least 60 years old, domiciled and resident in Haryana, and the combined annual income of the applicant and spouse from all sources must not exceed Rs 3,00,000. The service is designed as a proactive service using Parivar Pehchan Patra/department data.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: The current department page does not publish a complete document checklist or a detailed residence-proof test. Confirm the exact PPP data fields, bank validation requirements and whether a particular pension/annuity is counted under the 2024 amendment’s difference-payment rule.
schemes.exclusions_text: A person receiving a pension from the Government, local/statutory body or a substantially government-financed organisation is generally excluded; the departmental guidance treats PF, bank/financial-institution or insurance annuities as pension. The 2024 amendment allows a retiree receiving a smaller government/local/statutory pension or annuity to receive only the difference, subject to the scheme’s other conditions. Income above Rs 3,00,000, age below 60, non-Haryana residence/domicile or invalid/false data excludes the applicant.
schemes.documents_required: Parivar Pehchan Patra / Family ID; Age proof (normally the age record in PPP or an accepted government age document); Haryana domicile/residence evidence if the PPP record is incomplete; Bank account/passbook and consent for PFMS validation
schemes.conditional_documents: Pension/annuity statement where the applicant receives a lower pension and seeks payment of the difference; Additional income or residence proof requested by the DSWO during verification; Death/relationship proof where spouse income or household record needs correction
schemes.application_mode: Pro-active service based on PPP/CRID data; no ordinary application is required when the record is complete. A person missing from the proactive list should correct PPP data and approach the DSWO/SARAL route for verification.
schemes.application_steps: Ensure age, Haryana residence/domicile, spouse details, income and bank details are correct in PPP.; Allow the Social Justice department/DSWO to verify the proactive eligibility record and obtain beneficiary consent where required.; If not identified, use SARAL/PPP grievance or visit the DSWO with age, residence, income and bank evidence.; After approval, receive the pension ID and PFMS bank validation; payment is credited monthly.; Report death, change of residence, income or pension status to the DSWO so the record is stopped or recalculated correctly.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual application deadline or annual renewal stated. Beneficiaries remain eligible while conditions continue; PPP, bank and income records should be kept current and changes reported.
schemes.tracking_grievance: RTS timeline: 30-day validation plus up to 60 days for the notified service route; designated officer DSWO, first appeal ADC, second appeal DC. Department helplines: SARAL 0172-3968400 and Social Justice 0172-2715090; use PPP grievance for record errors.
schemes.source_authority: Government of Haryana, Department of Social Justice and Empowerment; Haryana Right to Service/SARAL service charter; official 2024 amendment notification
schemes.next_review_action: Obtain the current OASA KMS/notification checklist from the DSWO or department document page and verify the difference-payment treatment for pensioners before production use.

schemes.scheme_name: Haryana Divyang Pension Scheme (Disability Pension)
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana; DSWO/SEWA/HPPA for proactive data and consent; PFMS for payment
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 3,200 per month with effect from 1 November 2025, paid by PFMS. The 2025 rules state Rs 3,000 or the amount revised by Government, so the current departmental rate of Rs 3,200 governs.
schemes.eligibility_text: Generally, the applicant must be at least 18, be domiciled and resident in Haryana for at least three years immediately before applying, have a qualifying disability under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act/2025 Haryana rules, have annual personal income no higher than the minimum wage for unskilled labour notified by the Labour Department, and not be supported by specified close relatives such as parents, son or grandson. Persons with haemophilia, thalassemia or sickle-cell disease have no age limit and use a Rs 3,00,000 personal-income ceiling. The 2025 rules enumerate disability categories and include multiple disabilities; acid-attack and dwarfism may have separate treatment.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: The older department summary says disability must be 60–100%, but the superseding Haryana Divyang Pension Rules, 2025 do not state that percentage in the cited operative text. Confirm the current minimum percentage/benchmark and the accepted disability-certificate authority. Confirm the exact annual unskilled minimum-wage figure for the application date.
schemes.exclusions_text: Not eligible when age/residence/domicile, income, disability certification or family-support conditions fail; the rules also stop payment on death, loss of eligibility, two consecutive PFMS failures, specified criminal/FIR situations or false information. Existing pension/benefit overlap should be checked with the DSWO. The haemophilia/thalassemia/sickle-cell exceptions have separate age and income rules.
schemes.documents_required: Disability certificate/UDID or certificate issued by the competent Haryana health authority, showing the qualifying condition; Parivar Pehchan Patra / Family ID; Haryana domicile and at least three years’ residence evidence where not established in PPP; Personal income proof and/or PPP income record; Bank account/passbook for PFMS validation; Age proof for the ordinary 18+ route
schemes.conditional_documents: Medical records and disease-specific certificate for haemophilia, thalassemia or sickle-cell disease; Support/household declaration or evidence concerning parents/son/grandson support; FIR/court or correction documents where the department has flagged a record; Consent form and any additional documents requested by the DSWO during proactive verification
schemes.application_mode: Pro-active service from SEWA/HPPA/PPP data with DSWO consent and verification; if not identified, contact the DSWO/SARAL route with a disability certificate and the other records.
schemes.application_steps: Obtain or update the competent disability certificate/UDID and ensure disability, age, income, residence and bank fields are correct in PPP.; If identified through SEWA/HPPA, respond to the DSWO’s consent/verification request; otherwise file the notified SARAL/DSWO request.; Submit conditional medical, income and support evidence if the DSWO asks for it.; After approval, receive the pension ID; PFMS validates the bank account and begins monthly credit.; Report death, income, residence, support or other eligibility changes; correct bank failures promptly.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline or annual renewal stated. Benefit continues while eligibility is maintained; PFMS failures and changed conditions can stop it.
schemes.tracking_grievance: RTS route lists Disability Pension as a proactive service with DSWO as designated officer, ADC first appeal and DC second appeal. Department helplines: SARAL 0172-3968400 and Social Justice 0172-2715090; use the DSWO for disability-certificate or PFMS issues.
schemes.source_authority: Government of Haryana Gazette, Haryana Divyang Pension Rules, 2025; Department of Social Justice and Empowerment; official Haryana RTS information
schemes.next_review_action: Ask the department/DSWO for the post-2025 percentage threshold, current certificate format and current unskilled-wage value; do not auto-reject or approve on the 60% field until confirmed.

schemes.scheme_name: Ladli Social Security Allowance Scheme
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana; DSWO for verification and PFMS/DBT for payment
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 3,200 per month with effect from 1 November 2025. The allowance is payable for 15 years from the date either parent reaches age 45; it is paid to the mother if she survives, otherwise to the father. On reaching age 60, the beneficiary converts to Old Age Samman Allowance subject to that scheme’s conditions.
schemes.eligibility_text: The family must have only biological or adopted daughter(s) and no son, be Haryana-domiciled (or the parent(s) must be working for the Government of Haryana as specified), and have gross annual family income of no more than Rs 2,00,000. The eligible parent’s age trigger is 45; payment runs for 15 years from that trigger.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm from the current notification how ‘Haryana domicile or working for Government of Haryana’ applies to each parent, how income is calculated when parents live separately, and the exact conversion process at age 60. The current department page and the older KMS form differ on the monthly amount.
schemes.exclusions_text: Any biological/adopted son, gross family income above Rs 2,00,000, lack of Haryana domicile/qualifying government employment, age outside the 15-year parent-trigger window, duplicate/false records, or failure to provide required verification excludes the family. Older KMS material also states that specified government pensions/annuities can exclude the parent; confirm this against the current notification.
schemes.documents_required: Family ID / Parivar Pehchan Patra (mandatory in the current KMS checklist); Parent’s age proof: accepted examples include birth certificate, school certificate, driving licence, passport, PAN with photo or voter card/list with photo, with the KMS date restrictions; Haryana residence proof: Haryana ration card, Haryana voter card/list or self-declaration plus documentary proof verified by DSWO; Saving bank account/passbook of the receiving parent; Proof of daughters/no son and parent-child relationship as requested by the DSWO
schemes.conditional_documents: Aadhaar (listed as optional in the KMS checklist but useful for e-KYC); Death certificate of mother if payment is to father; Government employment/domicile proof where the parent relies on the government-employee route; Income/pension or annuity evidence if the department tests the older exclusion rule
schemes.application_mode: Online SARAL application or assisted application at a CSC/SARAL Kendra; DSWO/field verification followed by DBT. The RTS page classifies the service as a 60-day form service.
schemes.application_steps: Collect the parent’s age proof, residence proof, Family ID, bank passbook and daughter/no-son relationship evidence.; Submit the application through SARAL or a CSC/SARAL Kendra; pay no government fee (the KMS notes a possible Rs 30 CSC/SARAL service charge).; DSWO/field staff verify residence, age, family composition and income within the RTS period.; After approval, the allowance is credited to the eligible mother or, where applicable, father for the 15-year period.; Report changes and apply/coordinate the automatic transition to Old Age Samman Allowance at age 60.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No fixed annual deadline stated; apply once during the qualifying 15-year window. Eligibility and bank/family records must remain correct; conversion at age 60 is a key follow-up event.
schemes.tracking_grievance: RTS target 60 days; DSWO is the designated officer, ADC first appeal and DC second appeal. SARAL helpline 0172-3968400 and Social Justice helpline 0172-2715090; application form is available on the department website.

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.administering_body: Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department / Government of Haryana in coordination with the Government of India and the National Scholarship Portal (NSP); institution verifies the application
schemes.benefit_summary: Post-matric scholarship for eligible SC students, including academic allowance/maintenance support and reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees. The Haryana summary page lists a historical range of Rs 230–Rs 1,200 per month depending on course/group; current amounts should be taken from the applicable NSP/central guidelines rather than that summary.
schemes.eligibility_text: Student must be an SC student, a Haryana resident/domicile where the state route applies, enrolled in a recognised post-matric course/institution, and have parent/guardian annual income no more than Rs 2,50,000. Fresh and renewal applications are submitted through NSP in the current 2026-27 notice. The current framework also references additional allowances for eligible students with disabilities and compulsory non-refundable fee components.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm the current course-group rate, fee ceiling, income-certificate validity, domicile wording and whether all Haryana SC students must use NSP or whether any state portal is used for a particular institution. The 2025-26 and 2026-27 notices have different deadlines; use the active academic-year notice only.
schemes.exclusions_text: Non-SC status, Haryana/non-applicable domicile, parent/guardian income above Rs 2,50,000, non-recognised or non-post-matric course/institution, incomplete institution verification, duplicate/false applications or failure to meet NSP renewal/academic-continuation rules can exclude the claim. Amounts and fee reimbursement remain subject to the relevant central/state guideline and available entitlement.
schemes.documents_required: SC caste certificate; Haryana domicile/residence certificate where required by the NSP/state route; Valid family/parent or guardian income certificate showing annual income within Rs 2,50,000; Previous qualifying examination marksheet; Current admission/enrolment/bonafide certificate and fee receipt; Aadhaar/NSP One-Time Registration identity details and Aadhaar-seeded bank account in the student’s name or as accepted by NSP
schemes.conditional_documents: Disability certificate for additional allowance; Hostel certificate and other course-specific evidence; Family ID/PPP if requested for Haryana verification; Renewal applicants’ previous scholarship ID/renewal record and continuation certificate
schemes.application_mode: Online fresh/renewal application through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), with institution and department verification. The 2026-27 Haryana notice says applications are to be made on NSP; harchhatravratti is not the primary route in that notice.
schemes.application_steps: Create/maintain the NSP identity/OTR and verify Aadhaar, bank and mobile details.; Select the current Haryana/SC Post-Matric Scholarship scheme, complete fresh or renewal fields and upload the current certificates.; Submit before the active academic-year deadline and save the application ID/acknowledgement.; Ask the institution to complete verification and resolve any defect/objection on NSP before the portal’s correction/verification cut-off.; Track institute, district/state and payment status on NSP; contact the Haryana scholarship helpdesk/department for unresolved cases.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: For AY 2026-27, the official Haryana PRMS notice dated 11 September 2026 states a 31 January 2027 deadline. This is academic-year specific; do not reuse the 2025-26 notice’s 28 February 2026 deadline (or the separate PRMS page typo that says 2028). Renewal is required each academic year while the course continues.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Track application and payment in NSP and through the institution’s scholarship nodal officer. The official 2025-26 Haryana higher-education notice lists nspdghe@gmail.com and 0172-2565530; verify whether these remain the 2026-27 contacts before publishing them. Use the department/PRMS notice for the current helpdesk.
schemes.source_authority: Government of Haryana PRMS/SEWA and Directorate of Higher Education; National Scholarship Portal; Haryana Economic Survey 2025-26
schemes.next_review_action: At each academic-year refresh, read the current NSP/Haryana notice for course-group rates, exact document list, verification cut-offs and current helpdesk; reject stale 2025-26 dates.

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY) — revised HPSN/DAYALU-linked implementation
schemes.administering_body: Government of Haryana; CRID/Parivar Pehchan data for eligibility; Haryana Parivar Suraksha Nyas (HPSN) for the revised implementation and DAYALU-linked compensation; relevant departments/insurers for component schemes
schemes.benefit_summary: The original MMPSY framework offered eligible low-income families access to five central insurance/pension schemes using up to Rs 6,000 per family per year for premiums. Official Haryana Economic Survey 2025-26 says the implementation was revised from FY 2024-25: instead of reimbursing premiums, Rs 1,000 per eligible family per year is transferred to the bank account of the CEO, Haryana Parivar Suraksha Nyas for DAYALU compensation. This is not currently safe to describe as a direct Rs 6,000 applicant cash benefit.
schemes.eligibility_text: The official outcome framework describes the target as Haryana families with annual income up to Rs 1,80,000, identified through CRID/verified family data. The current Economic Survey confirms CRID-verified-income implementation and a 2025-26 budget allocation for eligible families. The original MMPSY operating framework also contained scheme-specific age, landholding and enrolment conditions, but the current revised SOP’s complete criteria were not found in a dedicated public service page.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Do not automate approval from income alone. Confirm the revised SOP’s current income ceiling, landholding/occupation conditions, family definition, component-scheme age criteria, whether the Rs 1,000 is an internal HPSN transfer rather than a beneficiary payment, and the current DAYALU claim process/portal. The original five-scheme model and 2024-25 revised model are materially different.
schemes.exclusions_text: Likely exclusions include failure of CRID/PPP verification, income or other revised-SOP conditions, duplicate/fraudulent family records, and failure to satisfy the separate component insurance/pension scheme rules. Because the current redesign is HPSN/DAYALU-linked, do not apply the old premium or age rules without confirming the current SOP.
schemes.documents_required: Parivar Pehchan Patra / Family ID with CRID-verified income and family details; Bank account linked to the verified family/authorized HPSN record where the current process requires one; Identity, death/accident/disability or other event documents required for a DAYALU/HPSN claim, if making a claim; Component-scheme documents (for example nominee/age/identity evidence) where a legacy insurance/pension entitlement is still being processed
schemes.conditional_documents: Landholding, occupation or income evidence if CRID cannot verify the household; Insurance/pension enrolment or premium evidence for a component scheme; Medical, death, FIR/post-mortem or disability certificate documents for a compensation claim, as specified by DAYALU/HPSN
schemes.application_mode: No current standalone MMPSY application form or public beneficiary portal was located. The revised implementation appears proactive through CRID/PPP and HPSN/DAYALU; users should correct Family ID data and use the HPSN/DAYALU/department route for a specific compensation or component claim.
schemes.application_steps: Check and correct family, income, bank and identity information in the official Parivar Pehchan system/PPP grievance route.; Ask the relevant department/DSWO/BDO or HPSN/DAYALU helpdesk whether the family is included under the revised current SOP; do not rely on old Rs 6,000 descriptions.; For a death, accident, disability or other covered event, collect the event and identity documents and submit through the current HPSN/DAYALU process once the official route is confirmed.; Track the claim with HPSN/DAYALU or the responsible component department and retain the acknowledgement.; Recheck eligibility when CRID income/family data or the annual implementation SOP changes.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No current public application deadline found. Implementation is budget/FY-based and proactive; component insurance/pension and DAYALU claims have their own event/notice deadlines that must be confirmed from the current HPSN SOP.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Use Parivar Pehchan/CRID grievance for family or income errors; contact the Haryana Parivar Suraksha Nyas/DAYALU responsible office for a claim once its current portal is confirmed; SARAL helpline 0172-3968400 can route a service query. No dedicated current MMPSY tracking URL was found.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
schemes.jurisdiction: India; State Health Agency implementation and state-specific databases may supplement the national list
schemes.administering_body: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; implemented with State Health Agencies
schemes.benefit_summary: Government-funded cashless and paperless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover up to Rs 5 lakh per eligible family per year, portable across India at empanelled public/private hospitals; packages include hospitalisation, defined day-care and pre/post-hospitalisation. All citizens aged 70+ are now eligible irrespective of income; 70+ members of already eligible families receive an additional top-up arrangement.
schemes.eligibility_text: Legacy/national entitlement: families identified in SECC 2011 rural deprivation D1-D5 and D7 (D1 one room kutcha walls/roof; D2 no adult 16-59; D3 no adult male 16-59; D4 disabled member and no able-bodied adult; D5 SC/ST; D7 landless households mainly dependent on manual casual labour), automatic-inclusion households (without shelter, destitute/living on alms, manual scavenger, primitive tribal group, legally released bonded labour), 11 defined urban occupational groups, and eligible legacy RSBY families not in SECC. States may use additional databases/convergence provided SECC-entitled families remain covered. A separate national entitlement covers every Indian citizen aged 70 or above, regardless of income; Aadhaar age is used for enrolment.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Eligibility is entitlement/list based rather than a normal open application. State expansions and package/state implementation differ. The current 70+ route is clear, but exact treatment of a 70+ person already covered by CGHS/ECHS/CAPF involves choosing the existing scheme or PM-JAY; private insurance/ESI does not bar PM-JAY. Verify the state beneficiary database before promising coverage.
schemes.exclusions_text: No general income test is applied to a listed PM-JAY family, but families absent from the applicable SECC/state/RSBY entitlement database cannot simply self-enrol. State-specific additions and exclusions may apply. Services excluded from standard packages include ordinary OPD care, drug rehabilitation, cosmetic treatment, organ transplant and fertility treatment; package and state rules govern remaining exclusions.
schemes.documents_required: For legacy family verification/card generation: ration card or family ID plus Aadhaar or another accepted government photo ID; mobile number helps search/OTP. At hospital, carry Ayushman card if available and Aadhaar/other government ID plus ration/family ID. For 70+ enrolment, NHA FAQ says Aadhaar is the only enrolment document and Aadhaar-based e-KYC is mandatory.
schemes.conditional_documents: Birth/marriage/adoption certificate plus Aadhaar of an existing verified member may be required to add a new household member; exact proof-of-relationship rules apply. State Health Agency may request state-specific family documents.
schemes.application_mode: Entitlement verification/card generation online through beneficiary portal or Ayushman App; assisted at CSC, government hospital, empanelled hospital/Ayushman Mitra or State Health Agency. No ordinary registration is required for the legacy entitlement; a 70+ person can enrol online.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Check beneficiary status on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call 14555. 2) Search using mobile, Aadhaar, ration/family ID or SECC details. 3) Complete e-KYC/card generation if listed, or visit CSC/Ayushman Mitra/government hospital with identity and family documents. 4) For treatment, choose an empanelled hospital, present card/ID, and request cashless pre-authorisation where required. 5) Keep the transaction/pre-authorisation record and use NHA/SHA grievance channels if refused.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No application deadline for the entitlement route found. Coverage is annual and ongoing while the person remains eligible; 70+ enrolment has immediate access per NHA FAQ, with no waiting period. Verify active card/beneficiary status before treatment.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Beneficiary portal: https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/; empanelled hospitals: https://hospitals.pmjay.gov.in/Search/; national helpline 14555 / 1800-111-565; hospital toll-free 14413; state SHA and NHA grievance systems. NHA says government hospitals (CHC and above) can assist with beneficiary verification.
schemes.source_authority: NHA/MoHFW primary guidelines and official PIB Cabinet release; portals are service channels and beneficiary databases are authoritative for an individual case

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.jurisdiction: Urban India; participating cities/towns/ULBs and notified planning areas
schemes.administering_body: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), through States/UTs, ULBs/UDAs and Primary Lending Institutions for ISS
schemes.benefit_summary: Four verticals: Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), Affordable Rental Housing (ARH), and Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS). BLC/AHP/ARH central assistance is released through States/UTs/implementing agencies, generally in 40%-40%-20% stages. ISS gives 4% interest subsidy on the first Rs 8 lakh of eligible home loan, with loan up to Rs 25 lakh, property value up to Rs 35 lakh, carpet area up to 120 sqm and maximum actual subsidy Rs 1.80 lakh/NPV Rs 1.50 lakh, in five annual instalments.
schemes.eligibility_text: Families in EWS (annual household income up to Rs 3 lakh), LIG (above Rs 3 lakh up to Rs 6 lakh) or MIG (above Rs 6 lakh up to Rs 9 lakh) living in urban areas and owning no pucca house anywhere in India. Beneficiary family is husband, wife, unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters. All family members require Aadhaar/Aadhaar Virtual ID integrated in the system. BLC is for EWS families constructing a new pucca house on available land; AHP is for EWS purchase in an approved project; ISS is for EWS/LIG/MIG purchase, re-purchase or construction via an eligible home loan; ARH has project/tenant-specific eligibility.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: State/UT may redefine EWS income with MoHUA concurrence. Application is vertical and city/ULB/project dependent. ISS also requires the loan to be sanctioned/disbursed on or after 01-09-2024 and a participating PLI. ARH eligibility and rent terms are project-specific.
schemes.exclusions_text: Not eligible if the beneficiary/family owns a pucca house anywhere in India; received a house under any Central, State/UT or local-government housing scheme in the previous 20 years; has already availed another PMAY-U 2.0 vertical; or is in a duplicate/curtailed PMAY-U list covered by the guideline exclusions. ISS subsidy is only once for a property and has additional loan/property/tenure exclusions. A beneficiary should not claim both PMAY-G and PMAY-U 2.0; MIS de-duplication applies.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar/Aadhaar Virtual ID for applicant and family members; mobile number; proof of urban address; household income self-certificate/affidavit; family details; bank/loan details for ISS; land ownership/title or land-right/patta evidence for BLC; project/application details for AHP/ARH; self-undertaking that no pucca house and no recent housing-scheme benefit exists.
schemes.conditional_documents: BLC: clear land title/patta and geo-tagging. AHP: project/beneficiary application and ULB verification. ISS: PLI loan documents, income self-certificate, property and loan-value evidence, PLI due diligence and geo-tagging. State/ULB may add residence, caste, disability, widow/single-woman or vulnerability proof for preference/priority.
schemes.application_mode: Online unified PMAY-U 2.0 portal, with ULB/State verification; AHP project applications through the unified portal; ISS through the portal and participating bank/HFC/PLI; BLC/ARH are routed through ULB/implementing agency and approved project lists.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Confirm city/ULB participation and choose BLC, AHP, ARH or ISS. 2) Go to PMAY-U MIS unified portal and select Apply for PMAY-U 2.0. 3) Read instructions, complete eligibility check and Aadhaar OTP authentication. 4) Enter personal, family, income, address and vertical-specific details. 5) Upload/submit undertakings and documents; receive application ID/receipt. 6) ULB/State or PLI verifies eligibility, de-duplicates against housing databases and sanctions/links the beneficiary. 7) For BLC, build with geo-tagged stages; for ISS, maintain the PLI loan and monitor subsidy credit; for AHP/ARH, follow the selected project/ULB process.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: Mission guidelines cover FY 2024-25 to FY 2028-29; citizen application windows/project/ULB/PLI schedules vary. ISS has no annual renewal application stated, but loan/subsidy conditions and five annual subsidy releases apply. BLC undertaking requires construction within the stipulated period (guideline undertaking states 12 months from first instalment).
schemes.tracking_grievance: PMAY-U MIS: https://pmaymis.gov.in; PMAY-U portal/dashboard and ULB/State nodal agency; MoHUA grievance/query link on https://pmay-urban.gov.in/index.php/pmay-u-2.0-guidelines; PMAY-U contact numbers listed by MoHUA: 011-23063285, 011-23060484, 011-23063620, 011-23063567, 011-23061827.

schemes.next_review_action: For each pilot city (Punjab, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Chandigarh), identify participating ULB, active verticals, state income definition, local document list and current PMAYMIS application status.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.administering_body: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, with State/UT Rural Development departments, Zilla Parishads and Gram Panchayats
schemes.benefit_summary: Construction assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh in plains and Rs 1.30 lakh in hill states/UTs, North-Eastern states, difficult areas and IAP districts; Rs 12,000 toilet support through SBM-G/MGNREGS/other source; 90 person-days unskilled MGNREGA labour in plains or 95 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas. Minimum house size is 25 sq m including hygienic cooking area. Funds are construction-linked DBT.
schemes.eligibility_text: Rural houseless households or households living in 0, 1 or 2-room kutcha-wall/kutcha-roof houses, identified from SECC-2011 housing deprivation and finalised Awaas+ lists, verified by Gram Sabha and ranked in the Permanent Wait List. Additional automatic-inclusion groups include households without shelter, destitute/living on alms, manual scavenger families, primitive tribal groups and legally released bonded labourers, subject to verification. The official self-survey checks rural residence, no pucca house, kutcha/houseless status, room count, assets, government employment, registered non-agricultural enterprise, monthly income, taxes and landholding.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Selection is list/Gram Sabha/target based rather than an unrestricted central online grant application. Current Awaas+ survey windows and State/UT inclusion process vary. The PMAY-G self-survey is a screening tool; final eligibility and priority come from SECC/Awaas+ verification, Gram Sabha and the Permanent Wait List.
schemes.exclusions_text: Self-survey screening excludes households with a pucca house; more than two rooms; motorised three/four-wheeler; mechanised agricultural equipment; Kisan Credit Card limit Rs 50,000 or more; government employee; registered non-agricultural enterprise; any member earning more than Rs 15,000/month; income-tax or professional-tax payer; irrigated land 2.5 acres or more; or unirrigated land 5 acres or more. Final SECC exclusion and Gram Sabha verification control.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar with consent; bank/post-office account; MGNREGA job-card number if available; mobile number; household-head photograph; land/plot or proposed construction site documents; family details and rural address; proof supporting landless/priority category where applicable.
schemes.conditional_documents: Landless households require State-arranged land/public land or land-rights evidence. Disability, caste/tribe, widow/unmarried status and other priority categories may require supporting certificates. Awaas+ self/assisted survey requires Aadhaar e-KYC/face authentication and geo-referenced photographs of existing house/proposed site.
schemes.application_mode: Not a conventional individual central-portal application. Apply/seek inclusion through Gram Panchayat/Gram Sabha, Block/Taluka development office, Panchayat Samiti, designated survey/Awaas+ process or e-Mitra/CSC where the State supports it; PMAY-G MIS/AwaasSoft and Awaas App are administrative channels.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Check PMAY-G eligibility screening questions and whether the household is in the SECC/Awaas+ Permanent Wait List. 2) Contact Gram Panchayat/Panchayat Secretary/Block Development Officer for inclusion or correction. 3) Complete Awaas+ self/assisted survey when the State window is open, with Aadhaar e-KYC and household/site photos. 4) Gram Sabha/appellate process verifies and prioritises the household. 5) State registers beneficiary in AwaasSoft, validates bank account and generates PMAY-G ID/sanction. 6) Construct in geo-tagged stages; receive construction-linked instalments and convergence benefits.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No permanent national citizen deadline; Awaas+ survey and State targets have time-bound windows. The official PMAY-G circular page records 2025 extensions for Awaas+ 2024 survey; check the current State/UT window. Once sanctioned, instalments follow construction milestones rather than annual renewal.
schemes.tracking_grievance: PMAY-G portal/dashboard: https://pmayg.nic.in; AwaasSoft/Awaas App and PMAY-G ID/sanction letter; Gram Panchayat, Block Development Officer, Chief Executive Officer/Zilla Parishad and State Rural Development grievance channels. State-specific grievance portals/helplines must be captured for the pilot.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY 2.0)
schemes.jurisdiction: India; connection issued by selected LPG Oil Marketing Company/distributor
schemes.administering_body: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas through Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) and LPG distributors
schemes.benefit_summary: Deposit-free LPG connection for eligible poor adult women, with Government cash assistance for connection (official portal lists Rs 2,050 for 14.2 kg or Rs 1,300 for 5 kg cylinder) and PMUY 2.0 migrant facility. Connection includes prescribed equipment/first refill terms as notified by OMC; exact current subsidy/refill terms should be verified with the distributor.
schemes.eligibility_text: Applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 or above, from a poor household based on the prescribed deprivation declaration, and the household must not already have an LPG connection from any OMC. PMUY categories include SC households, ST households, PMAY-G households, Most Backward Classes, AAY households, tea/ex-tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, island/river-island residents, SECC/AHL TIN households and poor households under the 14-point declaration. Applicant may be a migrant using prescribed self-declaration.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: OMC distributor performs household de-duplication and KYC; category evidence and deprivation declaration may be interpreted through OMC workflow. Availability of the 25-lakh additional allocation and exact current refill support should be confirmed on the portal/distributor.
schemes.exclusions_text: Adult men, applicants under 18, households with an existing LPG connection from any OMC, and applicants unable to establish poor-household/deprivation or required family/address details are not eligible. Duplicate household applications are rejected.
schemes.documents_required: KYC application form; Aadhaar copy of applicant; proof of address if Aadhaar address differs; State ration card or other State-government family-composition document; Aadhaar copies of adult family members listed in family document; bank passbook/cancelled cheque; prescribed deprivation declaration; mobile number and consent for e-KYC/DBTL.
schemes.conditional_documents: Migrant applicants may use Annexure I self-declaration for address and family composition. Category applicants may need SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY, MBC, forest-dweller, SECC/AHL or island/tribe evidence as relevant. Distributor may request additional KYC under OMC rules.
schemes.application_mode: Online through PMUY/selected OMC portal or offline by submitting documents to the applicant's chosen nearest LPG distributor; e-KYC can be self face-authenticated in the OMC app or completed through distributor/assisted channel.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Confirm no LPG connection exists in the household and gather KYC/family/bank/deprivation documents. 2) Use PMUY portal Apply for New Connection, select an OMC/distributor, or visit a distributor. 3) Submit KYC, family composition and deprivation declaration; complete Aadhaar e-KYC/biometric as requested. 4) Distributor verifies household de-duplication and releases connection under OMC process. 5) Complete safety demonstration/installation and retain consumer number; use OMC channel for refill/complaints.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No recurring annual renewal for the LPG connection found. Connection allocation is subject to Government/OMC quota and current portal availability; refill subsidies/support are policy-period dependent.
schemes.tracking_grievance: PMUY portal and chosen OMC/distributor; PMUY helplines 14438, 14428, LPG emergency 1906, MOPNG e-Seva. Use consumer number/application acknowledgement for follow-up.
schemes.source_authority: Official PMUY/MoPNG portal and OMC application workflow
schemes.next_review_action: Confirm current OMC application links, state-specific distributor availability, exact PMUY 2.0 connection package and current refill subsidy before user-facing publication.

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS) under NSAP
schemes.jurisdiction: India; implemented through State/UT social-welfare machinery and local bodies
schemes.administering_body: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, through State/UT departments and Gram Panchayat/Municipality/local verification
schemes.benefit_summary: Central assistance under NSAP of Rs 200 per month for eligible BPL persons aged 60-79 and Rs 500 per month for persons aged 80 or above; States/UTs may add top-up amounts and set payment/eligibility procedures. Payments are generally periodic DBT or State-authorised pension channels.
schemes.eligibility_text: Person aged 60 or above belonging to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household, with age 80+ receiving the higher central rate. Applicant must establish identity, age, address and BPL/poverty status under the State/UT implementation process. The scheme is for individual old-age social assistance and is normally processed through local government rather than a national self-service grant portal.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: State/UT may use updated deprivation/income databases, add state assistance, prescribe residence/domicile and define application/payment channel. The central guideline says BPL; current State interpretation and whether an applicant is already covered must be verified locally.
schemes.exclusions_text: Not eligible under the central IGNOAPS component if under 60, not in the applicable BPL/poor-household category, cannot establish residence/identity, or is already receiving a conflicting duplicate social pension under State rules. State top-up schemes may have additional exclusions.
schemes.documents_required: Model NSAP application asks for photograph, name, parent/spouse name, gender, date of birth or proof of birth, category, full address, Gram Panchayat/Ward, Block/Sub-District, District, State/PIN, Aadhaar number, ration-card number and EPIC/voter ID number. Bank/post-office account details are needed for DBT where used by the State.
schemes.conditional_documents: Age proof may be birth certificate, school/official record or State-accepted age document; BPL/poverty proof is database/local verification dependent; disability/widow/caste documents are not required for IGNOAPS itself unless used for another NSAP component or State priority.
schemes.application_mode: Offline/local application through Gram Panchayat, Municipality/Ward office, Block/District Social Welfare/Rural Development office or State pension portal where available. The national NSAP portal is principally monitoring/status infrastructure, not a universal national application form.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Obtain the State/UT pension application or NSAP model form from Gram Panchayat/Ward office/Block Social Welfare office. 2) Submit age, identity, residence, BPL/poverty and bank details. 3) Local body verifies household status and forwards the case to the designated State authority. 4) Receive sanction/pension ID and payment through DBT or State channel. 5) Check local pension list/payment status and lodge grievance with local body, district authority or State social-welfare department.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No single national annual deadline found. Applications are generally accepted under State/UT pension calendars; life verification, Aadhaar/bank validation or annual renewal may be required under State rules. Amount changes when beneficiary reaches 80.
schemes.tracking_grievance: NSAP portal/dashboard: https://nsap.nic.in/; Gram Panchayat/Municipality, Block/District social-welfare authority and State pension portal. The NSAP Guidelines include social-audit/grievance processes; capture state contact and payment-status URL for pilot states.
schemes.source_authority: Ministry of Rural Development NSAP Guidelines and Social Audit Guidelines; State/UT pension authority controls case-level sanction

schemes.scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
schemes.jurisdiction: India; central DEPwD scheme implemented through National Scholarship Portal and institute/state verification
schemes.administering_body: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment; National Scholarship Portal (NSP), institutes and State/District nodal verification
schemes.benefit_summary: For eligible Class XI-XII, diploma, degree and postgraduate students: tuition/admission fee support up to Rs 1.40 lakh, other fee up to Rs 10,000, book allowance Rs 1,500/year, disability allowance Rs 2,000-4,000/year, and maintenance support Rs 1,200/month hosteller or Rs 650/month day scholar for 12 months, subject to the applicable revised guideline and course limits. Payment is DBT/PFMS.
schemes.eligibility_text: Indian national; student with benchmark disability of 40% or more under the RPwD framework and valid disability certification/UDID; studying Class XI/XII, diploma, degree or postgraduate course in an eligible recognised institution; annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh; not receiving another post-matric scholarship or stipend. Maximum two children with disabilities from the same parents may receive the scholarship. Scholarship is generally for one class/academic year, with renewal subject to current rules and progression.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: DEPwD revised umbrella guidelines were issued in 2024/2025 and NSP opening/verification dates are academic-year specific. The accessible DEPwD page is a plain-language summary and says to check latest rules. Institution/course recognition, renewal progression and exact allowance category must be confirmed in NSP scheme specifications/FAQ.
schemes.exclusions_text: Non-Indian nationals; disability below 40% or no valid certificate/UDID; family income above Rs 2.5 lakh; students receiving another post-matric scholarship/stipend; ineligible/non-recognised course or institution; more than two disabled children from same parents (subject to scheme exceptions/verification); incomplete or unverified application.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar; UDID card/UDID number (or permitted enrolment/disability certificate under current NSP rule); recent photograph; previous academic-year marksheet; current admission/enrolment/bonafide certificate; student bank passbook/cancelled cheque; family-income certificate; fee/tuition details; institute and course details; category/residence details as requested by NSP.
schemes.conditional_documents: Hosteller certificate/hostel proof for hosteller allowance; disability-specific certificate/UDID and reader/escort/helper evidence where applicable; renewal marksheet and previous scholarship details; institute verification documents; state/district income or domicile certificate if NSP asks.
schemes.application_mode: Online through National Scholarship Portal; student registration/application followed by institute verification and DNO/SNO/MNO verification, then DEPwD sanction and DBT/PFMS. Assisted application may be obtained through school/college, caregiver or CSC.
schemes.application_steps: 1) Confirm the active Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities listing on NSP and read Specifications/FAQ. 2) Register/login on NSP, complete OTR/profile and Aadhaar/identity requirements. 3) Select DEPwD Post Matric Scholarship, enter course/institute, disability, income and bank details, upload documents and submit. 4) Track defective/institute/DNO-SNO-MNO verification and correct defects before the published date. 5) After sanction, monitor PFMS/DBT payment and renew in the next academic year if eligible.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: For AY 2026-27, NSP currently lists scheme opening 25-07-2026 and student application closing 31-10-2026; defective and institute verification close 15-11-2026; DNO/SNO/MNO verification closes 30-11-2026. Dates can be extended/changed by NSP. Renewal is academic-year based and must be checked in the live listing.
schemes.tracking_grievance: NSP application dashboard/Specifications/FAQ and institute nodal officer; DEPwD scholarship page https://depwd.gov.in/en/scholarship-post-matric/; NSP helpdesk/grievance tools; institute, State/District nodal officer and DEPwD contact. PFMS can be used to trace DBT after sanction.

schemes.next_review_action: Open current NSP Specifications and FAQ for this exact scheme, capture 2026-27 document fields and renewal rules, and confirm whether Punjab/Haryana/Himachal/Chandigarh institute/nodal workflows add certificates.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY / Mukhya Mantri Sehat Yojana (MMSY)
schemes.jurisdiction: Punjab; state-entitlement treatment in empanelled hospitals in Punjab and Chandigarh
schemes.administering_body: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Punjab; State Health Agency Punjab; National Health Authority for central PM-JAY component
schemes.benefit_summary: Punjab's 2025 notification describes cashless treatment up to Rs 10 lakh per family per year in government and private empanelled hospitals in Punjab and Chandigarh. Older AB-PMJAY/AB-MMSBY material describes Rs 5 lakh per family per year for eligible categories; current card entitlement must be confirmed with SHA.
schemes.eligibility_text: The 2025 Punjab notification describes bona fide Punjab residents and family members. Registration requires Aadhaar plus Voter ID as Punjab-residence proof; for a child under 18, the child's Aadhaar plus parent/guardian Voter ID. It includes outsourced/contractual/consultancy employees of Punjab government bodies and regular Punjab Government employees and pensioners. Family includes head, spouse, unmarried children, parents, widow/divorcee and minor children, and widow daughter-in-law and minor children. Historical AB-MMSBY routes also covered smart-ration-card families, construction workers, small traders, journalists and farmers.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm whether the Rs 10 lakh MMSY is universal or category-specific, live family-member database rules, current 2026 document/category list and how existing PM-JAY/other coverage is handled.
schemes.exclusions_text: A person covered by ESI, CGHS or another central/state insurance or reimbursement scheme can claim under only one scheme. Non-central-funded state entitlement is limited to empanelled hospitals in Punjab and Chandigarh; central-funded entitlement follows NHA guidelines.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar and Voter ID; for a minor, minor Aadhaar plus parent/guardian Voter ID. Carry mobile and identity details if requested by the live workflow.
schemes.conditional_documents: Possible older AB-MMSBY category evidence: smart ration card/ration-card data, farmer J-form/land record, construction-worker card, small-trader registration, journalist accreditation or other SHA/NHA category proof; current exhaustive list pending.
schemes.application_mode: Online through NHA beneficiary portal/Ayushman app where enabled; assisted registration at CSC/Sewa Kendra, SHA camp or empanelled hospital. The notification confirms identity documents but not the complete live workflow.
schemes.application_steps: Check the family in SHA/NHA search; present Aadhaar/Voter ID; complete verification and generate e-card; select an empanelled hospital; hospital completes pre-authorisation and cashless treatment; retain card, authorisation and claim number for follow-up.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No application closing date found; ongoing subject to active eligibility, card verification and annual/family entitlement rules. Confirm any re-verification.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Use SHA/NHA beneficiary/card search and hospital Arogya Mitra/PM-JAY desk. Current SHA grievance number and exact path were not exposed by reviewed official pages.

schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Government of Punjab; District Social Security Officer
schemes.benefit_summary: Official Punjab district information and a January 2025 district release state Rs 1,500 per month. Current 2025 service PDF confirms service and application process but not amount or eligibility thresholds.
schemes.eligibility_text: Punjab resident; man aged 65+ or woman aged 58+; total annual income from all sources not more than Rs 60,000. Age/income are in the 2017 amendment notification and current district Social Security information; confirm at district level.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Current service document omits age/income and amount. Confirm whether income is individual/family, treatment of pension income, and whether a newer circular changed thresholds.
schemes.exclusions_text: No separate current exclusions list. Duplicate pension, death, non-residence, income above ceiling or failed age/verification checks may stop sanction; verify locally.
schemes.documents_required: Identity: Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, Driving Licence or PAN. Address: Passport, Voter ID, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar or government/PSU address certificate. DOB: Aadhaar, Voter/electoral roll, birth certificate or matric certificate. Bank passbook/account.
schemes.conditional_documents: Mismatch resolution, local residence/income evidence if requested, and guardian/representative documents where needed.
schemes.application_mode: Sewa Kendra; Connect Punjab (connect.punjab.gov.in); or DSD doorstep assistance via 1076.
schemes.application_steps: At Sewa Kendra take token and submit the form-free request/documents (official PDF says government/facilitation fee NIL). On Connect register/profile, select pension service, upload and submit. For DSD call 1076, confirm documents and schedule home visit. Keep acknowledgement.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No deadline found. Indicative disposal: up to 34 days Sewa Kendra/DSD and 32 days Connect. Continued eligibility/periodic verification needs confirmation.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Track Connect/eServices or acknowledgement; call 1100 for service support and 1076 for DSD. Escalate via District Social Security Officer and notified appellate authority/Deputy Commissioner.
schemes.source_authority: Punjab current service PDF and Social Security district/department pages; 2017 notification for eligibility; 2025 district release for amount
schemes.next_review_action: Ask a District Social Security Officer for current sanction/benefit circular and verify income definition, periodic verification and amount.

schemes.scheme_name: Aashirwad Scheme
schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities / SC and BC Welfare Department, Government of Punjab
schemes.benefit_summary: Marriage assistance for eligible Punjab families. Detailed official application PDF last revised August 2017 says Rs 15,000; official Punjab 2019 achievements document says amount increased from Rs 15,000 to Rs 21,000. Current amount is unresolved and must not be hard-coded.
schemes.eligibility_text: Older official rules: bride at least 18; parents/guardians permanent Punjab residents; annual family income from all sources not more than Rs 32,790; maximum two assisted girls per family. Listed groups include SC, Christian, backward class/caste, economically backward class girls, daughters of widows of any caste, and SC widows/divorced women remarrying. Older form says apply after marriage date is fixed and before marriage, with late applications up to 30 days after marriage.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Current landing page gives no detailed rules. Confirm live community categories, income ceiling, two-girl limit, late filing rule, current coverage and SC-widow/divorcee rule.
schemes.exclusions_text: Under older rules: bride below 18, income above ceiling, no permanent Punjab residence, more than two assisted girls, or unsupported/late application outside permitted window. Current exclusions unpublished.
schemes.documents_required: Residence proof; bride DOB proof; self-declaration/income certificate; verification by Sarpanch, Gazetted Officer, Panch, Nambardar, Ward Councillor, Nagar Council President, Mayor or MLA; bank details. BPL/blue card optional in older form.
schemes.conditional_documents: BPL/blue card; caste/community certificate; widow/death or divorce/remarriage evidence; marriage proof/date and identity/address documents as requested.
schemes.application_mode: Current landing page directs registration/login at Connect Punjab. Older official form describes Sewa Kendra and historically post submission; confirm current route.
schemes.application_steps: Confirm current amount/category with SC/BC Welfare; collect residence, DOB, income/category and bank documents; register on Connect or apply through instructed Sewa Kendra/local office; submit before marriage (or only confirmed late window); retain acknowledgement and track through Connect/district office.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: Older rule: after marriage date fixed and before marriage; late up to 30 days after marriage. One-time assistance, no renewal. Current deadline needs confirmation.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Use Connect tracking and district SC/BC Welfare office; general Punjab support 1100, but current scheme-specific grievance route was not stated.
schemes.source_authority: Punjab official scheme landing page and SC/BC Welfare application PDF; Punjab Government achievements document for historical amount increase

schemes.administering_body: Department of Social Welfare, Women and Child Development, Chandigarh Administration
schemes.benefit_summary: Monetary old-age pension paid through Chandigarh Social Welfare. Current official ServiceOnline entry does not publish amount; an older government report and non-primary webpages suggest Rs 1,000/month, but this is unconfirmed for 2026.
schemes.eligibility_text: Current official service requires an old-age applicant, age proof and proof of three years' Chandigarh residence. It does not expose age threshold, current income cap or household definition. An older government report states annual family income up to Rs 1.50 lakh for old-age, widow and disability pensions, but this needs current confirmation.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Confirm minimum age, annual income ceiling, Chandigarh residence test, treatment of other pensions and current amount.
schemes.exclusions_text: Current official page has no exclusions list. Likely checks include duplicate pension, failure of residence/age/income criteria, death or incorrect bank details; treat these as verification questions, not confirmed rules.
schemes.documents_required: Aadhaar; residence proof for three years (telephone bill, ration card or electricity bill examples); age proof such as birth certificate; bank passbook/account details. ServiceOnline lists Aadhaar twice.
schemes.conditional_documents: Additional residence/age/income or identity documents; other-pension/death evidence for duplicate-benefit checks; bank mandate/cancelled cheque if requested.
schemes.application_mode: Online through Chandigarh ServiceOnline; assisted/in-person through e-Sampark or Social Welfare. e-Sampark says citizen visits Social Welfare with all documents for verification.
schemes.application_steps: Create/login to ServiceOnline and choose Old Age Pension, or visit e-Sampark/Social Welfare; submit Aadhaar, 3-year residence, age and bank documents; attend verification/respond to query; keep acknowledgement; follow up if notified service period expires.

schemes.tracking_grievance: Use ServiceOnline acknowledgement/status where available and contact Social Welfare/e-Sampark. Current service page lacks scheme-specific grievance URL/helpline; use Chandigarh RTS escalation after 30 days.

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme (HIMCARE)
schemes.administering_body: Himachal Pradesh Swasthya Bima Yojana Society, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.benefit_summary: Cashless treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 per family per year in empanelled hospitals. A unit is capped at five members; additional family members may be enrolled as a separate unit. Premium: zero for Category I, Rs 365/year for Category II and Rs 1,000/year for Category III.
schemes.eligibility_text: Category I: BPL households not covered by Ayushman Bharat, registered street vendors not covered by AB-PMJAY, MNREGA workers with at least 50 days in the preceding/current financial year, and orphanage children. Category II: Ekal Naris (widows, divorced, legally separated and unmarried women over 40), persons with disability above 40%, mid-day meal workers and eligible state-controlled daily-wage, part-time, contractual and outsource workers. Category III: families not in I/II and not government servants/pensioners or their dependent family members.
schemes.eligibility_unresolved: Recheck whether current category definitions, premium rates and AB-PMJAY overlap rules changed after the cited official page/2025 quarterly notice. The enrollment portal says a ration card enrolled under PMJAY cannot submit HIMCARE.
schemes.exclusions_text: Households already enrolled/entitled under AB-PMJAY cannot use this HIMCARE route; government servants/pensioners and their dependents are excluded from Category III. Wrong category, mismatched ration/Aadhaar data, unpaid premium, duplicate unit or incomplete uploads can cause rejection; treatment must be at an empanelled hospital.
schemes.documents_required: Himachal ration card number and clear front/back scans; Aadhaar/identity details and mobile number; Category proof: recent attested BPL certificate where applicable; Bank/payment details when premium is due
schemes.conditional_documents: Street-vendor registration certificate; MNREGA job card plus MIS report showing at least 50 days; CDPO certificate for Ekal Nari; Permanent medical disability certificate above 40%; Department certificates for mid-day meal, daily-wage, part-time, contractual or outsource workers; Birth/marriage/adoption/death certificate for family-member changes
schemes.application_mode: Online at the official HIMCARE enrollment portal or assisted through a Lok Mitra Kendra/Common Service Centre. New registration/renewal is scheduled in March, June, September and December; policy validity is one year.
schemes.application_steps: Check that the ration card is not enrolled under PM-JAY and select the correct category.; Register the ration card without the HP prefix; upload clear front/back scans and complete family, Aadhaar, address and mobile fields.; Upload category proof; for paid categories pay the displayed premium within 30 days after confirmation.; Track enrollment, correct defects and download the e-card after approval.; Use an empanelled hospital and renew from the official renewal page before expiry.
schemes.deadline_or_renewal: No final one-time deadline. New registration/renewal is opened for one month in March, June, September and December under the 2025 process; card validity is one year. Incorrect submissions should be resubmitted within 60 days after action.
schemes.tracking_grievance: Status on hpsbys.in/app.hpsbys.in. Toll-free 18002021311; card approvals 7018606884 and 7008605212; technical support 8091773886; technicalquerieshpsbys@gmail.com. Official portal lists a three-day PSGA limit.
